use_cases.name: Pre-approve overtime against a line budget
use_cases.goal: Require overtime above configured thresholds to be pre-approved against a line or cost-centre overtime budget, and flag unapproved overtime before payroll lock.

stakeholders.interest: Overtime spend stays within the approved budget per line.
Overtime worked with approval is paid correctly and on time.
Planned overtime never exceeds statutory weekly limits.

use_cases.trigger: A supervisor plans overtime for a line, for example to meet a rush order at Peenya Machining.
preconditions: An overtime budget in hours and amount exists per line or cost centre per month.
Overtime eligibility is resolved per worker from class and assignment (RL-130).
Thresholds requiring pre-approval are configured, for example more than 2 hours per worker per day.
postconditions_success: Approved pre-approvals reserve budget; actual overtime is matched to them and payable overtime flows to the run that will pay it.
postconditions_failure: Unapproved overtime is flagged before payroll lock and is not paid until approved or rejected.

main_flow.action: Requests pre-approval for 4 hours of overtime for 6 operators on shift A at Peenya Machining on 2026-11-14.
Checks each worker's overtime eligibility and projected weekly hours against the state limit.
Shows the line's remaining budget and the projected cost of the request at the state multiplier.
Approves the pre-approval, reserving 24 hours against the November budget.
Records actual punches; the attendance engine derives overtime minutes for each worker.
Matches actual overtime to the pre-approval and releases any unused reserved budget.
Before payroll lock, lists overtime above threshold with no matching pre-approval.
Resolves each flagged item by obtaining retrospective approval or marking it non-payable with a reason.
Tags approved overtime to the run that will pay it.

steps: The request routes to the next approval level with the overspend shown.

alternate_flows.condition: Actual overtime exceeds the pre-approved hours.
steps: The excess is flagged as unapproved and handled at step 7.

exception_flows.condition: The request would take a worker beyond the statutory weekly limit.
exception_flows.handling: The approver is warned with the limit named; approval requires a recorded reason.
The worker is excluded from payable overtime; raw minutes are retained for reporting.

nfrs: The budget check returns within 1 s.
The unapproved-overtime list for a site of 2,000 workers is produced in under 30 s.

user_stories.want: to request overtime pre-approval with the budget impact shown
user_stories.so_that: I can plan extra hours without overspending

acceptance.given: Peenya Machining has 120 of 400 November OT hours left
acceptance.then: the request shows 96 hours remaining after approval and the projected cost

acceptance.given: E1030 is a trainee with no overtime eligibility
acceptance.then: E1030 is excluded from payable hours with the reason shown

user_stories.want: unapproved overtime flagged before I lock inputs
user_stories.so_that: we never pay overtime nobody approved

acceptance.given: E1018 worked 3 hours overtime on 2026-11-16 with no pre-approval
acceptance.then: E1018's 3 hours are listed as unapproved

acceptance.given: Plant HR marks it non-payable with a reason
acceptance.then: the hours are excluded from pay and retained for reporting

user_stories.want: a warning when pre-approval would exceed weekly limits
user_stories.so_that: we do not plan unlawful hours

acceptance.given: E1019 already has 58 hours that week and the limit is 60
acceptance.then: the approver sees the limit warning and must enter a reason

acceptance.given: the approver rejects it
acceptance.then: the rejection reason is recorded

use_cases.name: Reconcile canteen and transport usage with attendance
use_cases.goal: Reconcile canteen consumption and company transport usage with attendance at plant sites for subsidy, deduction and roster planning.

stakeholders.interest: Subsidies are paid only for meals and trips actually used by eligible workers.
Deductions are accurate and can be checked.
Canteen and bus capacity match shift rosters.

use_cases.trigger: The canteen or transport vendor feed for a day is received, or the monthly reconciliation is due.
preconditions: Canteen and transport feeds identify the worker by badge or employee code.
Subsidy and deduction rules by worker class and meal or route are configured.
postconditions_success: Usage is reconciled with attendance, mismatches are resolved, deductions are passed to payroll and subsidies to finance.
postconditions_failure: Unresolved mismatches are excluded from deductions and listed for follow-up.

main_flow.action: Receives the canteen and transport feeds for Peenya Works for 2026-11-04.
Matches each meal and bus boarding to the worker's attendance day and shift.
Flags mismatches, such as a meal claimed on an absent day or boarding without a shift.
Reviews mismatches and marks each as valid, vendor error or recoverable.
At month end, computes deductions per worker and the subsidy per vendor by worker class.
Receives deductions as payroll inputs for the month.
Receives the subsidy summary per vendor and cost centre for payment.
Reviews usage against roster for next month's canteen and bus capacity.

steps: Reconciliation for that day is deferred and flagged; deductions wait for the feed or a manual upload.

exception_flows.condition: A badge in the feed does not map to any active worker.
exception_flows.handling: The entry is quarantined and reported to the vendor; no deduction is made.

exception_flows.condition: A deduction would take net pay below the protected floor.
exception_flows.handling: The deduction is capped and the remainder carried forward, flagged for payroll.

nfrs: A day's feed for 2,000 workers reconciles in under 2 minutes.
Employees can view their own usage and deductions in self-service.

user_stories.want: meal and bus usage matched to attendance automatically

acceptance.given: 1,180 meals served at Peenya on 2026-11-04 and 1,172 matched to present workers
acceptance.then: 8 mismatches are listed for review

acceptance.given: a badge not linked to any active worker
acceptance.then: the entry is quarantined and no deduction is made

user_stories.want: to see my canteen and transport deductions by day
user_stories.so_that: I can raise a query if something is wrong

acceptance.given: I am E1029 with 22 meals and 22 bus trips in November
acceptance.then: I see each date and the deduction per item

acceptance.given: a meal is recorded on a day I was on leave
acceptance.then: it routes to Plant HR with the entry attached

user_stories.want: subsidy totals per vendor and cost centre
user_stories.so_that: I pay vendors only for reconciled usage

acceptance.given: November reconciliation is closed
acceptance.then: totals by vendor and cost centre exclude unresolved mismatches

acceptance.given: a vendor error is confirmed
acceptance.then: the vendor total is reduced accordingly

use_cases.name: Declare work location and book a desk
use_cases.goal: Let office employees declare their work location, book desks and see team presence, with location feeding attendance rules.

stakeholders.interest: Can plan office days and find a desk near the team.
Knows who is where and can plan team days.
Work-from-home limits and attendance rules apply correctly.

use_cases.trigger: An employee plans the week or arrives at the office.
preconditions: The hybrid policy for the employee's group is configured, for example 3 office days a week for Bengaluru Corporate Office staff.
Desk layouts per floor are configured for the location.
postconditions_success: Declared location and desk booking are recorded and the attendance day is derived under the rules for that location.
postconditions_failure: A declaration that breaches policy is held for manager approval and attendance is not credited as office presence.

main_flow.action: Opens the week planner and declares office on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday and home on the other days.
Checks the declaration against the hybrid policy and shows remaining home days for the month.
Books a desk on floor 3 near the team for each office day.
Views team presence for the week and sees which days most of the team is in.
On an office day, punches in at the Bengaluru Corporate Office entry.
Matches the punch to the declared location and confirms the desk booking.
Derives the attendance day using the rules for office or home working as declared.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee declares a client site.
steps: The employee names the client site and the day is attended as on-duty with the manager notified.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee does not arrive by 11:30.
steps: The desk is released for others to book.

exception_flows.condition: The declaration exceeds the monthly home-working limit.
exception_flows.handling: The extra home day is routed to the manager for approval.

exception_flows.condition: The employee declared home but punched in at the office.
exception_flows.handling: The day is derived as office presence and the declaration is updated with a note.

nfrs: The team presence view for 50 people loads in under 2 s.
Only the declared location category is shown to colleagues, never precise location.

user_stories.want: to declare my weekly work location and book desks
user_stories.so_that: my office days are planned and my attendance is correct

acceptance.given: a policy of 3 office days a week
acceptance.when: I declare Monday, Wednesday and Thursday as office
acceptance.then: the plan is accepted and I can book desks for those days

acceptance.given: I have used all home days for November
acceptance.then: it is routed to my manager for approval

user_stories.want: to see team presence by day
user_stories.so_that: I can set team days when most people are in

acceptance.given: my team of 9 at Bengaluru Corporate Office
acceptance.then: I see each person's declared location by day

acceptance.given: Wednesday has 8 of 9 in the office
acceptance.then: Wednesday is highlighted as the best team day

user_stories.want: attendance derived from the declared location
user_stories.so_that: home and office days follow the correct rules

acceptance.given: E1011 declared home on 2026-11-06 and logged on remotely
acceptance.then: it is recorded as work from home, not absent

acceptance.given: E1011 declared home but punched in at the office
acceptance.then: it is recorded as office presence with a note

use_cases.name: Accept opt-in presence signals from wearables or beacons
use_cases.goal: Allow a site to accept presence signals from approved wearables or access beacons only with recorded consent and without continuous location tracking.

stakeholders.interest: Participation is voluntary, revocable and limited to presence at defined points.
Fewer missed punches in large plant areas.
Consent and purpose limitation meet the DPDP Act 2023 (to be validated by Legal).

use_cases.trigger: A site enables beacon-based presence and invites workers to opt in.
preconditions: Approved beacons are registered at defined points such as plant gates and shop-floor entry.
A consent notice for this purpose is published in the worker's language.
postconditions_success: Presence events from consenting workers are stored as punches at defined points only, with the consent reference.
postconditions_failure: No signal from a non-consenting worker or outside defined points is stored.

main_flow.action: Enables beacon presence at Chakan Works gates and shop-floor entry points.
Reads the consent notice in Marathi and opts in from the mobile app.
Records the consent with purpose, scope, timestamp and notice version.
Passes a gate beacon with the paired wearable at 16:52.
Records a single presence event for that point and time as a punch, linked to the consent.
Discards any signal not at a defined point and stores no movement trail.
Derives the attendance day using these punches like any other enrolled source.

steps: The worker continues to use the biometric terminal; nothing is recorded about the decision beyond the consent status.
Beacon presence stops immediately and future days use other sources.

exception_flows.condition: A signal arrives from a wearable with no active consent.
exception_flows.handling: The signal is dropped without storage.

exception_flows.condition: Two beacon events at the same point within the dedupe window.
exception_flows.handling: The second is marked duplicate and retained, not discarded.

nfrs: No stored record contains a location trail between defined points.
Consent withdrawal takes effect within 1 minute.

user_stories.want: to opt in to beacon presence and withdraw at any time
user_stories.so_that: I control whether it is used

acceptance.given: I am E1045 at Chakan Works
acceptance.when: I opt in after reading the Marathi notice
acceptance.then: my consent is recorded with the notice version

acceptance.given: I withdraw consent
acceptance.when: I pass a gate beacon one minute later
acceptance.then: no presence event is stored

user_stories.want: only presence at defined points stored
user_stories.so_that: we do not track workers continuously

acceptance.given: a wearable passes three undefined points and one gate beacon
acceptance.then: one punch at the gate is stored and nothing else

acceptance.given: an audit request
acceptance.when: I export beacon data for October
acceptance.then: every event shows a defined point and a consent reference

user_stories.want: beacon punches treated like any other source

acceptance.given: E1045 passes the gate beacon at 16:52 and the exit beacon at 03:05 next morning
acceptance.then: the D-shift day shows first in 16:52 and last out 03:05

acceptance.given: two gate beacon events 20 s apart
acceptance.then: the second is marked duplicate and retained
